clue.text: India to engage in diplomatic relations, it's understood

indicators.note: to engage in something is to take part inside it, so the India letter goes within the other piece

parts.note: tact is the delicate handling that diplomatic relations need
India is I in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A news item about India entering into formal diplomatic ties with another country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to engage in' puts I inside TACT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unspoken but implied is understood without being said, the adjective's exact sense.

clue.text: It's more or less important a mountaineer carries it

indicators.note: the phrase important a mountaineer carries the letters within it, spanning its words

explanation.surface: A mountaineer must carry something vital up the hill with them.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run from the end of 'important' through 'a' into 'mountaineer'. 'Important' looks like part of the definition but is mostly fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Something equivalent in effect amounts more or less to the same thing.

clue.text: Bragged about Germany being very busy

indicators.note: about means surrounding here, so the bragging word goes round the letter for Germany

parts.note: crowed means boasted or bragged
D is the international vehicle code for Germany

explanation.surface: Someone boasted about how hectic things are in Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts CROWED around D.
explanation.definitionFit: A place packed with people is full and bustling, so very busy fits.

clue.text: Far from a little money for one's cup of tea?

parts.note: thin means meagre or slight, a little of something
G is slang for a grand, a thousand pounds or dollars

explanation.surface: A wry remark that one's favourite pastime costs far more than pocket change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Far from' is the setter's irony: a G (a grand) is far from a little money, even a thin one.
explanation.definitionFit: Your cup of tea is your particular liking or preference, a common informal idiom.

clue.text: Beautiful water reflecting the Eastern Baltic

indicators.note: reflecting means mirrored, so the word for water is read backwards

parts.note: the sea is a body of water

indicators.note: only the eastern, right-hand end of Baltic is wanted, so its western start is dropped

explanation.surface: Water mirrors the scenery of the eastern Baltic coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reflecting' turns SEA into AES; 'Eastern' takes the final letters TIC of BALTIC, leaving off BAL.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective relates to beauty or artistic appreciation, so beautiful or tasteful fits.

clue.text: What could be running Wigan and Oldham?

definitions.meaning: track and field events include running races
Wigan Athletic and Oldham Athletic are English football clubs

explanation.surface: Wondering what might be operating in two Lancashire towns.
explanation.walkthrough: Wigan and Oldham are towns in north-west England whose football clubs are both called Athletic.
explanation.definitionFit: Track and field sport includes running; the plural also names both clubs called Athletic.

clue.text: 'Sound of Music' producer lets staff go

indicators.note: the sound of a word is how it is spoken, so the instrument is taken by ear

parts.note: a sax, a saxophone, is an instrument that produces music

explanation.surface: The producer of the film The Sound of Music lays off employees.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'Sound of Music' as the film title; split it, and 'Sound of' signals a word heard, SAX.
explanation.definitionFit: To fire workers is to dismiss them, the informal verb for letting staff go.

clue.text: Exaggerated language contrived by rep in tricky situation

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the rearranged letters go within the word for a tricky situation

parts.note: being in a hole means being in a tricky situation

indicators.note: contrived means artificially arranged, so the letters of by rep are rearranged

explanation.surface: A sales rep uses overblown talk to get out of a fix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contrived' rearranges 'by rep' into YPERB, then 'in' sets it inside the hole.
explanation.definitionFit: This figure of speech is deliberate overstatement, extravagant claims not meant literally.

clue.text: Worth moving out of bed to be sick

indicators.note: moving the letters of worth about rearranges them

parts.note: up means risen, out of bed

explanation.surface: Is it worth dragging yourself out of bed when you're feeling ill?
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' turns WORTH into THROW.
explanation.definitionFit: Vomiting is being sick, and this phrasal verb is the informal term for it.

clue.text: At first 'chop chop chops' will do it

indicators.note: at first points to the opening letter of the word that follows

parts.note: to hew is to chop with an axe

explanation.surface: A cook's instruction repeated briskly: chop, chop, and that will finish it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chops' here means jaws, which do the work in question.
explanation.definitionFit: Jaws, informally chops, grind food with the teeth, so they perform this action.

clue.text: Age-old ethnic conflict over crude oil

indicators.note: one rearranged word spreads over the other, enclosing it
conflict suggests things in turmoil, so the letters of ethnic are disordered
crude means unrefined or rough, so the letters of oil are rearranged

explanation.surface: A long-running ethnic war fought over control of unrefined petroleum.
explanation.walkthrough: The two anagrams give NETHIC and OLI; 'over' wraps the first round the second.
explanation.definitionFit: The New Stone Age is ancient prehistory, so the adjective can mean extremely old.

clue.text: Quietly encourage the removal of undesirables

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
to urge someone on is to encourage them

explanation.surface: Someone discreetly egging on the ousting of unwanted people.
explanation.definitionFit: A political clean-out ejects disloyal or unwanted members, a removal of undesirables.

clue.text: Demeanour of dad getting involved with gangster war?

indicators.note: getting involved suggests things mixed up together, so the letters of dad and gangster war are mixed

explanation.surface: How a father behaves once he gets mixed up in a gangland feud.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes a hostile, openly antagonistic manner, a bearing or demeanour.

clue.text: 'Top Gear' star on prime time previously

indicators.note: previously means earlier, so the time piece comes before the prime piece

parts.note: the sun is a star
a day is a period of time
prime means the best

explanation.surface: A star of the motoring show Top Gear appears in a prime-time slot.
explanation.walkthrough: Top Gear is a BBC motoring programme; here 'top gear' means one's finest clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Your finest clothes, kept for church or special occasions, are your top gear in the sense of attire.

clue.text: Command British to leave frontier

indicators.note: to leave means to depart, so the British letter is taken away

parts.note: a border is a frontier

explanation.surface: Instructing British forces to withdraw from a frontier.
explanation.definitionFit: An instruction from authority, as in giving the command to fire, is a directive.

clue.text: Staggered around church carrying base of font back in

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the staggering word goes round the church piece

parts.note: reeled means staggered or lurched

indicators.note: carrying means holding inside, so the church letters hold the bottom letter

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: in a down clue the base of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Someone lurched round a church, lugging the base of a font back inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carrying' gives CTE, which 'around' puts inside the staggering word after its fifth letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Being returned to office for another term puts a politician back in power.

clue.text: Boast of good timekeeper texting you on the spur of the moment

definitions.text: on the spur of the moment

parts.note: a punctual person might boast that they are prompt, written I'M PROMPT
U stands for you in text messages

explanation.surface: A punctual person brags in a text message to a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Done without preparation or planning means improvised on the spur of the moment.

clue.text: Heavy-gutted, endlessly vomiting, in awful pain — get a doctor!

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the pieces go within the rearranged pain
awful suggests things in a bad way, so the letters of pain are scrambled
gutted means emptied of insides, leaving only the outer letters of heavy
endlessly means the last letter is removed

parts.note: being sick is vomiting

explanation.surface: A desperate patient's symptoms tumble out with a plea for medical help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awful' gives PIAN, and 'in' places HYSIC (from 'gutted' and 'endlessly') inside it after the P.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical practitioner, especially in general medicine, is a doctor.

clue.text: Latest top place for Princeton University

parts.note: new means the latest
a jersey is a knitted top

explanation.surface: Princeton University's newest venue rises to the top spot.
explanation.walkthrough: A jersey is a pullover, a top in British usage.
explanation.definitionFit: Princeton University is located in this US state, so it is the place for it.

clue.text: Spiderman sounded out for IT post?

indicators.note: sounded out means spoken, so the description of the hero is taken by ear

parts.note: Spiderman is a web male, a man of the web

explanation.surface: A question about how the superhero's name is pronounced in a technology job advert.
explanation.walkthrough: Spiderman spins webs and is a man, a web male; spoken, that matches the email term.
explanation.definitionFit: Email accessed through a browser is electronic post, mail of the IT age.

clue.text: Declined to live going back and forth with daughter

parts.words: to live going back and forth
parts.note: to live is to be, BE; going back it reads EB, then forth it reads BE, giving EB then BE

explanation.surface: A daughter's life is a constant shuttle between two homes, wearing her down.
explanation.walkthrough: BE is read backwards then forwards: EB followed by BE.
explanation.definitionFit: The tide going out recedes, and figuratively anything waning has declined in this way.

clue.text: Animals coming from farm finally leaving spreaders of TB?

indicators.note: leaving means departing, so the end letter of farm is removed

parts.note: tuberculosis is spread by bad germs

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word farm

explanation.surface: British farmers blame these wild animals for spreading bovine TB to cattle.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain badgers are accused of passing tuberculosis to cattle, so the clue is nearly all-in-one.
explanation.definitionFit: These black-and-white burrowing mammals are animals, here the subject of farming controversy.

clue.text: Engineer blends dynamite without paying attention

indicators.note: to engineer is to construct, so the letters are rebuilt into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A careless engineer mixes explosives while not concentrating.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting distractedly, with the mind elsewhere, means doing so without paying attention.

clue.text: Stone to sacrifice the Spanish in Andean capital

indicators.note: to sacrifice something is to give it up, so the Spanish article is dropped

parts.note: La Paz is the seat of government of Bolivia, high in the Andes
la is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: A traveller gives up a Spanish companion in a mountain city, perhaps for a gemstone.
explanation.definitionFit: This yellow gemstone is a precious stone used in jewellery.

clue.text: Poor support for GP's practice

indicators.note: in a down clue a support sits below, so the poor piece comes under the doctor piece

parts.note: a GP, general practitioner, is a doctor, DR
poor in health means ill

explanation.surface: A doctor's surgery gets inadequate backing.
explanation.definitionFit: Repeated exercise or rehearsal, as in fire practice, is a training routine.

clue.text: Craving sex before church

indicators.note: before means ahead of, so the sex piece comes first

parts.note: it is slang for sex

explanation.surface: A desire for sex before a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong desire, as in an itch to travel, is a craving or yearning.

clue.text: Brown amphibian (tailless, by the way)

indicators.note: tailless means without the end letter

parts.note: a toad is an amphibian
ST, street, is a way

explanation.surface: A brown amphibian that has lost its tail, remarked on in passing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tailless' turns TOAD into TOA.
explanation.definitionFit: To brown bread under the grill is to make it crisp in this way.

clue.text: Gripe at work about iniquitous special treatment

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the rearranged letters go round the wicked piece
at work means operating, so the letters of gripe are reworked

parts.note: vile means wicked or iniquitous

explanation.surface: A complaint at work about unfair favouritism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at work' gives PRIGE, which 'about' wraps round the wicked piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A special right or advantage granted to some and not others is special treatment.

clue.text: Sleep very lightly, maybe Nero's beginning his sex?

parts.note: to doze is to sleep lightly, so a half doze is a very light sleep

indicators.note: beginning means the first letter of the word Nero

explanation.surface: A sleepy question about the emperor Nero's sex life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sex' mimics how six sounds in a New Zealand accent; 'his' makes it Nero's. Nero is the Roman emperor.
explanation.definitionFit: Six is half of twelve, a dozen halved, here disguised as sex.

clue.text: Scorer of Lazio's third in sequence

indicators.note: in means inside, so the picked letter goes within the word for a sequence

parts.note: a list is a sequence of items

indicators.note: third points to letter three of Lazio

explanation.surface: A footballer who scored Lazio's third goal in a run of wins.
explanation.walkthrough: Lazio is an Italian football club; 'Scorer' means someone who writes musical scores, a composer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hungarian pianist wrote orchestral and piano scores, so he is a composer, a scorer.
